name: S2S-Arena
description: An arena-style speech2speech benchmark evaluating instruction-following capabilities with paralinguistic information in both speech input and output across real-world tasks. It includes 154 samples spanning four domains and 21 tasks, focusing on the challenges of understanding and generating paralinguistic cues in speech models.
reputation: A newly proposed speech-to-speech benchmark with a small but focused scope, mainly relevant to researchers studying paralinguistic instruction following in speech models.
notes: Focuses on paralinguistic information in speech understanding and generation; uses manual evaluation in an arena-style setup.
